usdassetgroups.description: Asset containers. Each Group is one named USD asset container - a root layer together with the sublayers, references, payloads, textures, MaterialX documents and volumes it needs. The Group id is the asset container identifier.

rootlayer.name: rootlayer
rootlayer.description: The assetidentifier of this container's single RootLayer usdasset, so a Consumer finds the composition entry point without scanning the collection

usdassets.description: A single USD artifact - a layer, package, texture, MaterialX document, volume or manifest - served as a document

format.name: format
format.description: The document format of this artifact. Orthogonal to assetkind, which records the artifact's role in the closure

assetidentifier.name: assetidentifier
assetidentifier.description: The authored USD asset identifier, normalized relative to its asset container - the string a layer writes between @...@. It is the Resource source identity and the authority: the usdassetid is the symbolic identifier constructed from it, a one-way construction that is never inverted

assetkind.name: assetkind
assetkind.description: The role this artifact plays in its container's composition closure. Exactly one usdasset in an asset container has the value RootLayer

dependson.name: dependson
dependson.description: The asset identifiers this artifact directly references, in authored order - authored identifiers, not xids, so a resolver matches them against @...@ references directly

digest.name: digest
digest.description: Lower-case hexadecimal digest of the exact document bytes a Consumer retrieves, computed with digestalg

digestalg.name: digestalg
digestalg.description: The algorithm used to compute digest. REQUIRED when digest is present

usdschemaplugingroups.description: USD schema plugins. Each Group is one codeless USD schema plugin, and the Group id is the plugin name as declared in the plugin manifest. A codeless schema needs exactly two files, so a Group holds a SchemaPlugin usdasset and a GeneratedSchema usdasset

usdassets.description: A single file of this schema plugin - its plugin manifest or its generated schema - served as a document

format.name: format
format.description: The document format of this artifact. Orthogonal to assetkind, which records the artifact's role in the closure

assetidentifier.name: assetidentifier
assetidentifier.description: The authored USD asset identifier, normalized relative to its asset container - the string a layer writes between @...@. It is the Resource source identity and the authority: the usdassetid is the symbolic identifier constructed from it, a one-way construction that is never inverted

assetkind.name: assetkind
assetkind.description: The role this artifact plays. Within a usdschemaplugingroup the value is SchemaPlugin for the plugin manifest and GeneratedSchema for the generated schema

dependson.name: dependson
dependson.description: The asset identifiers this artifact directly references, in authored order - authored identifiers, not xids, so a resolver matches them against @...@ references directly

digest.name: digest
digest.description: Lower-case hexadecimal digest of the exact document bytes a Consumer retrieves, computed with digestalg

digestalg.name: digestalg
digestalg.description: The algorithm used to compute digest. REQUIRED when digest is present
